subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**from**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the preposition "**from**".
 
• We use the preposition "**from**" to show the origin place where someone or something starts.<
